slides.what_it_does: Three mana, does nothing by itself. Tap another creature to load it with charge counters equal to that creature's power. At seven it's a 4/5 with flying and vigilance.
slides.best_home: Any deck already running a few mid-size creatures. One seven-power attacker switches it on in a single turn.
slides.take: The card off the top unlocks the first time you charge it each turn. You still pay for it, but you don't wait until seven.

cards.name: Deep Space 9
cards.take: Nine mana. Four cards off the top when it lands and again every upkeep, and every permanent among them hits play.

cards.name: Captain Jean-Luc Picard
cards.take: Three mana, pumps the team, and makes an Officer every time you cast a creature or a Spacecraft.

cards.name: Borg Cube
cards.take: Costs less for every artifact creature you control. Exiled creatures come back as yours.

slides.question: Spacecraft in your decks, or is Station too slow?
